environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway with IAM authorization. Lambda execution role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/MigrationPermBoundary) that restricts secrets:GetSecretValue to only the specific rotation-enabled secret ARN. The RDS Proxy (rds-proxy-migration.proxy-abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com) is configured with IAM authentication mode and the associated secret in AWS Secrets Manager has automatic rotation enabled with a custom Lambda rotator on a 60-second schedule (RotationRules.AutomaticallyAfterDays replaced by RotationRules.Duration=60s via custom CloudFormation resource). The RDS Proxy enforces connection pinning with SessionPinningFilters and the target PostgreSQL role has pg_read_all_data privilege only (no write, no DDL, no EXECUTE on functions). Network: Lambda is in an isolated subnet with a security group (sg-0def456) that only allows egress to the RDS Proxy endpoint on port 5432 via a VPC endpoint policy that restricts rds-db:connect to the specific proxy resource ARN.

config.vpc_security_group_egress: sg-0def456 (port 5432 to RDS Proxy endpoint only)
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: restrict rds-db:connect to proxy ARN only
config.network_isolation: private subnet, no internet gateway, no NAT
